hook: 27 detectors to find network faults in seconds

beats.say: PcapAnalyzer is a free, open-source tool: upload a pcap capture and it tells you what is failing, why, and what to check next.
It runs 27 detectors on every capture, covering TCP retransmissions and firewall resets, DNS and DHCP failures, path problems, TLS issues, broken VPN tunnels and port scans.
It runs on your own machine, so captures never leave your network, and it is currently in beta under the Apache 2.0 license.
